answer: Make trust accrue like sediment against a jetty: a new identity's answers earn nothing until established peers extend small, slashable vouches, and every vouch has an anchor in the voucher's own stake, so one bad sponsorship dents the sponsor. An attacker standing on a knoll of fresh accounts must buy real vouches at rising cost or wait out epochs of good behavior, and clones cannot vouch for each other because shared control links their stakes, so a single slash drains the whole cluster.
